adjudication.NO_REPRESENTATION_ROBUST_GAIN: target robust and no representation has positive median canonical d3 gain
adjudication.REPRESENTATION_ROBUST_ED1_GAIN_NOT_MATCH: target robust and d3 gains have lower CI>0 all, but >=1 canonical median d3>0.15
adjudication.REPRESENTATION_ROBUST_ED1_MATCH_ONLY: target robust; canonical robust d3<=0.15 all representations and d3 gains have lower CI>0 all, but full Q4 criterion fails
adjudication.REPRESENTATION_ROBUST_FULL_Q_MATCH: target robust; canonical robust d3<=0.15 all representations; d3 gains have lower CI>0 all; and finite median robust d4<=0.15 all representations
adjudication.REPRESENTATION_SENSITIVE_OR_UNRESOLVED: target robust but directional gain is not robust across all representations and at least one representation has positive median gain

parsing.clean_word_rule: retain only words composed entirely of full two-character STA members [A-Z][0-9a-z], all of which occur in the verified STA-aaa table
parsing.drawing_interruptions: split at <->; no adjacency is permitted across an interruption
parsing.uncertain_or_nonclean_word: exclude and split adjacency at that position
parsing.unit_encoding: injective single-Unicode-codepoint analytical encoding before the unchanged ED1 scorer

primary_test.gain: robust d3(CIPHER_ONLY) - robust d3(canonical); positive favors origin-state mechanism
primary_test.metric: d3 = Euclidean log-ratio distance on ED1_N0, ED1_N1, ED1_N3 to each newly measured Voynich target
primary_test.robust_directional_gain: lower 95% bootstrap CI of median gain > 0 for all three Voynich representations
primary_test.robust_match: robust directional gain AND median canonical robust d3 <= 0.15 for all three representations

purpose: Correct the Voynich-facing Saltzman/origin-state test to the upstream binding RF/STA/aaa representation hierarchy without retuning the synthetic mechanism.

representations.AAA_CONNECTED: apply the verified STA-aaa table member-by-member inside the original RF word; '~' separates analytical units, ':' remains inside a connected unit
representations.RF_MEMBER: each full two-character STA member is one edit-distance unit
representations.STA_FAMILY: each full STA member is collapsed to its leading uppercase family; one family is one edit-distance unit

secondary_tests.E1: worst absolute log E1 error across ATOMIC/LITERAL where finite; paired gain baseline minus mechanism
secondary_tests.Q4: log-distance including E1 where both arms are finite; report coverage and gains, no imputation
secondary_tests.legacy_Q: retain old [1.1642,1.1039,1.0257,1.0182] only as archaeological reference, not as the corrected target

stopping_rule: No mechanism retuning follows a failure. A positive ED1 result may proceed only to a separately frozen representation-matched held-out consequence panel.

synthetic_replay.robust_distance: for each document/arm/Voynich representation take max distance over ATOMIC and LITERAL synthetic representations

target_estimation.target_vector: median Q4 over the 20 frozen null seeds for each representation

target_robustness.binding_pass: all three representation medians pass the inherited structural thresholds AND >=80% of target null-seed Q4 rows pass in every representation
target_robustness.median_gate: apply the inherited ED1_N0/E1/order/ED1_N3 structural thresholds to each representation-specific median Q4
target_robustness.qualitative_secondary: also record Q1>1, Q1>Q2>Q3, |log Q3|<|log Q1|, and E1 in [0.90,1.10]

upstream_binding.representation_rule: RF member -> STA family -> connected aaa; correlated projections, not independent replications
